title: Sludge Spinner
move_pattern: Randomly cycles between Oil Spray, Slam, and Rage (no consecutive repeats). Rage is hidden from the bestiary but still used in combat.
notes: The Rage move is hidden from the bestiary display (ShouldShowMoveInBestiary returns false for RAGE_MOVE), meaning players won't see this move listed when viewing the monster in the bestiary, but it will still be used during combat.
